cases.input: Please update the credit card on file for my account. The current one expires next month.
cases.expected_summary: Customer wants to replace the payment card on their account before it expires.
cases.notes: Lesson 2 called this 'clear' and the model split 18/2. Payment-method changes sit on the account/billing line; GUIDELINE rule 3 decides it.

cases.input: hi, i was charged twice for my subscription this month and the app also keeps crashing when i open settings. can someone sort this out
cases.expected_summary: Customer was charged twice this month and the app crashes on the settings screen.
cases.notes: Two real complaints. Rule 4: money leads. A summary that drops the crash is a worse summary even when the category is right.

cases.expected_summary: Customer cannot log in; no details given.
cases.notes: Three words. Tests whether the model invents details the email does not contain.

cases.input: i was billed $49.99 twice on mar 3 and since the update yestrday the export button just spins forever. need the extra charge back and exports working.
cases.expected_summary: Customer was charged $49.99 twice on March 3 and the export button spins indefinitely since yesterday's update.
cases.notes: Rule 4: money leads. Summary must name both the duplicate charge and the broken export — same trap as c002 with a different surface.

cases.input: hi i was suposed to get a refnd for my cancleation last week but i still se the charge on my statment can u help??
cases.expected_summary: Customer says they still see a charge for a cancelled subscription and expected a refund last week.
cases.notes: Misspellings only; intent is clear. Tests whether sloppy spelling changes classification or makes the model hallucinate amounts.

cases.input: Could you send me a copy of my invoice for January? I need it for my accountant.
cases.expected_summary: Customer requests a copy of their January invoice for their accountant.
cases.notes: Straightforward invoice request. Baseline billing case with no boundary ambiguity.

cases.input: Oh great, another update that 'improves performance' and now the dashboard won't load at all. Really loving this product. Been trying for 20 minutes.
cases.expected_summary: Customer says the dashboard will not load after a recent update; no other details given.
cases.notes: Sarcasm is tone, not category. Complaint is a broken dashboard after an update; summary should state the problem, not echo the sarcasm.

cases.input: Every time I click Save on the profile page I get 'Error 500' and my changes are lost.
cases.expected_summary: Customer gets Error 500 when saving on the profile page and changes are not saved.
cases.notes: Profile page sounds like account, but the issue is a server error on save — technical per guideline, not a login or credential problem.

cases.input: The mobile app crashes immediately when I open any notification.
cases.expected_summary: Customer reports the mobile app crashes when opening notifications.
cases.notes: Clear bug report with no boundary ambiguity.

cases.expected_summary: Customer says they are locked out; no details given.
cases.notes: Two words. Same trap as c003: model must not invent why they are locked out or what they already tried.

cases.input: مرحبا I forgot my password and I can't access my account. ممكن تساعدوني reset it please?
cases.expected_summary: Customer forgot their password and cannot access their account; asks for help resetting it.
cases.notes: Arabic greeting and plea mixed with English — typical bilingual support inbox. Category is account; summary stays in English and does not translate filler words.

cases.input: I'd like to change the email address on my account from john@old.com to john@new.com.
cases.expected_summary: Customer wants to change the email address on their account from john@old.com to john@new.com.
cases.notes: Profile/access change with no login failure and no billing dispute.

cases.input: Your pricing page doesn't say whether the Team plan includes SSO. Before we buy I'd like a straight answer.
cases.expected_summary: Customer asks whether the Team plan includes SSO before purchasing.
cases.notes: Pre-sales product question — general, not technical (nothing is broken) and not billing (no charge or refund in play).

cases.input: How do I export my data to CSV? I looked in Settings but couldn't find the option.
cases.expected_summary: Customer asks how to export data to CSV and could not find the option in Settings.
cases.notes: Guideline rule 2: a how-to about a feature that may simply be hard to find is general, not technical.

cases.input: Thanks for fixing the login issue last week — everything's working fine now.
cases.expected_summary: Customer thanks support for a resolved login issue; no request stated.
cases.notes: No actionable request. 'general' is correct even though login is mentioned in passing.

cases.input: تم خصم اشتراكي مرتين هذا الشهر من نفس البطاقة. أرجو إرجاع المبلغ الزائد.
cases.expected_summary: Customer says their subscription was charged twice this month on the same card and wants the extra charge refunded.
cases.notes: Entirely in Arabic — no English in the input. Tests whether the model classifies and writes an English summary from Arabic-only text.
